name: RUCKUS
note: RUCKUS's recommended configuration, shown to readers as the "RUCKUS recommends" column. Keep ONLY values confirmed against RUCKUS guidance here — a verified column is presented as authoritative, so an unconfirmed value is worse than an absent one. Values are keyed by level; a key at the apgroup level is a different setting from the same key at venue level. See api/baselines.py.
